source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("informal settlements" OR slums) AND (digital OR "mobile phones" OR smartphone OR platform)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("informal settlements" OR slums) AND (digital OR "mobile phones" OR smartphone OR platform),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("informal settlements" OR "slums") AND ("mobile phones" OR "digital" OR "platform" OR "smartphone"))
